brief.summary_1line: Rama calms the enraged Lakshmana, urging patience and acceptance of exile as destiny while refusing to blame Kaikeyi or resist his father's vow.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lakshmana stands trembling with rage like a furious elephant while Rama gently speaks to him, calming him amid the royal chamber.
Rama respectfully circumambulates Queen Kaushalya before preparing to leave the palace for the forest.
Sacred coronation vessels filled with water stand unused as Rama declares they may instead serve for his dedication to an ascetic life.
